svg.text: one sweep per run at a time
at most 500 per view, 100 per batch
each batch kept as soon as read
the By process view, fetched about
once a second, opens no file twice
after a DAG update rules read
not_needed while jobs were to come
and queued every ended SLURM job
a read past the 5 s timeout was
thrown away: the cache never filled
the shared pool full, file routes 503
fixed in 1abf966, one sweep per run
